blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations to actions with no objective that accounts for how the world responds, so their robustness is bounded primarily by data coverage. World models carry precisely that missing objective and are better grounded for it, yet rolling the future forward costs seconds per decision and rules them out of the control loop. We show the two can be separated. What a world model knows about physical scenes lives in its internal features ; generating the future is merely the objective that produced them, so the grounding can be inherited while the generative machinery is left behind. We add one feature-alignment term to ordinary VLA training: a frozen world model is run over the training frames once and cached, and the student learns to agree with that cache. No teacher is loaded during training, the projector is discarded after it, and the deployed policy is identical to the undistilled baseline, running in 32 32 ms and 1.86 1.86 GB on a consumer RTX 5090, so every gain is attributable to the representation rather than to added capacity or test-time compute. A 0.8 0.8 B student reaches 97.9 % 97.9\% on LIBERO, improves from 48.2 % 48.2\% to 50.5 % 50.5\% on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, and the same objective carries over to real hardware, on both a single-arm and a bimanual platform. The gain survives changes of student scale, backbone, alignment layer, and teacher, indicating a broad representational prior rather than a fragile alignment between two particular networks. Project page: https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/ .
blocks.zh: 展望-语言-行动(VLA)模型绘制了对没有考虑到世界如何应对的目标的行动的观测图,因此其稳健性主要以数据覆盖为限. 世界模型恰好背负着这个缺失的目标,并且对此有更好的基础,然而将未来的前进成本秒逐一滚动,并排除它们进入控制圈. 我们显示两者可以分开。 一个世界模型对物理场景的知之在于其内部特征;创造未来仅仅是产生这些场景的目标,因此地基可以继承,而基因机械则被留下. 我们在普通的VLA训练中增加了一个特征调整术语:一个被冻结的世界模型在训练框上运行一次并被缓存,学生学会同意缓存. 在训练期间没有教师被装载,投影仪在训练后被丢弃,所部署的政策与未固定的基准相同,在消费的RTX 5090上运行了32个32米和1.86个1.86个GB,所以每个收益都归因于表示,而不是增加容量或测试时间计算. 在LIBERO上,0.8名B级学生达到97.9%,在RoboCasa-GR1人机操纵上从48.2%48.2%提高到50.5%;在单臂和双人机平台上,同样的目标也延续到真正的硬件上。 收益在学生规模、骨干、校正层次和教师等变化中存活下来,表明两个特定网络之间有着广泛的代表性,而不是脆弱的校正。 项目网页:https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a compelling paradigm for general-purpose robot control: by using large vision-language backbones as the foundation and training them to predict robot actions, they inherit strong semantic understanding and scale efficiently to diverse tasks [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . In practice, however, VLAs are brittle to environmental perturbations such as viewpoint shifts, lighting changes, and clutter that are underrepresented in their training data [ 5 ] , and adapting them to unseen tasks or new embodiments takes a large amount of additional data [ 6 ] . The cause is structural. Standard VLA training maps observations to actions with no explicit pressure to model how the world evolves in response to those actions, so a policy can fit its training distribution well without ever learning temporally grounded or causally consistent representations. Robustness then becomes primarily a function of data coverage, which is expensive and ultimately insufficient.
blocks.zh: Vision-Language-Action(VLA)模型是通用机器人控制的有说服力的范式:通过将大型的视觉语言骨干作为基础并训练他们预测机器人行动,它们继承了强大的语义理解并高效地扩展到多种任务[1,2,3,4]. 然而,在实践中,志愿行动军对环境动荡十分脆弱,例如观点转变、照明变化以及培训数据中代表性不足的杂乱无章[5],使其适应无形的任务或新的表现需要大量的额外数据[6]。 原因是结构性的。 志愿军标准培训地图描绘了对没有明确压力的行动的观察,以模拟世界如何因应这些行动而演变,因此,一项政策能够很好地适应其培训分布,而不会从时间上或因果上学习一致的表述。 然后,稳健性主要成为数据覆盖面的一项功能,而数据覆盖面昂贵,最终不足。

blocks.en: World models take the opposite approach. Instead of learning only to emit controls, they are trained to model the future environment, often by jointly predicting future frames, states, and actions. This additional burden forces the model to internalize temporal structure and causal consequence, yielding representations that are more physically grounded than those of an action-only policy. Recent work reports that policies built this way transfer better to new tasks [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] and degrade far more gracefully under perturbation [ 5 ] . The benefit comes at a practical cost: rolling the world forward is much more expensive than predicting an action directly. DreamZero [ 6 ] requires 3s per inference on an H100, given several layers of optimization (caching, kernel fusion, quantization, distillation) to become usable, whereas π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 3 ] runs in 65ms on a consumer RTX 5090 and our own 0.8 0.8 B policy in 32ms on the same card (Fig. 1 ), at 1.86GB against DreamZero’s 45.9GB, which the card cannot hold. A world model is therefore attractive as a source of knowledge and (currently) unattractive as a deployed policy.
blocks.zh: 世界模式采取相反的做法。 他们不是只学习放出控制,而是接受过模拟未来环境的培训,往往通过共同预测未来框架、状态和行动。 这一额外负担迫使模式将时间结构和因果内部化,产生比只行动政策更具有实体基础的表述。 最近的工作报告说,这些政策通过这种方式更好地转向新的任务[6、7、8],并在扰动下更加优雅地退化[5]。 好处是以实际代价产生的:把世界推向前进比直接预测行动要昂贵得多。 DreamZero [6] 要求每推出一个H100, 鉴于几层优化(caching, 内核聚变, quantization, 蒸馏), 因此,世界模式作为一种知识来源具有吸引力,而且(目前)作为一种部署政策不具吸引力。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: A 0.8 0.8 B policy at the accuracy of models several times its size. (a) LIBERO four-suite mean success rate against parameter count. (b) What one inference costs, against the 32 32 GB of a consumer RTX 5090.
blocks.zh: 图1:A 0.8 0.8 B 以模型的精确度为大小数倍的政策. (a) LIBERO四套平均成功率相对于参数计数。 (b) 消费者RTX 5090的32 32 GB的推论费用。

blocks.en: This tension motivates our question: can a lightweight VLA be trained to inherit the grounded representations of a large world model without paying its inference cost? We answer yes, and with a mechanism far cheaper than the question suggests. The key observation is that what a world model knows about physical scenes is already present in its internal features ; the expensive part, generating the future, is only the objective that produced them. A student can therefore be supervised on the features alone.
blocks.zh: 这种紧张激起我们的问题:轻而易举的VLA能否在不支付推论费用的情况下,被训练来继承一个大世界模型的基础代表? 我们回答是的,并且有一个比问题所暗示的便宜得多的机制。 关键观察是,世界模型对物理场景的了解已经存在于其内部特征中;产生未来的昂贵部分只是产生这些场景的目标。 因此,学生可以单独接受特征监督。

blocks.en: We instantiate this as a representation-alignment objective on the student’s visual pathway, with a frozen world-model supplying the target. Two design choices make the objective cheap. Because the teacher is frozen, its targets depend only on the training frames and can be extracted once, ahead of time, and read back during training instead of recomputed; and because the student is asked to agree with those targets in direction rather than reproduce them exactly, it is free to retain whatever additional structure its action objective demands, and the two backbones need not share a feature space or a dimensionality. What follows is a distillation procedure that is invisible from both ends. Training never holds a teacher in memory, so a distilled run costs what the baseline run costs; the alignment head is auxiliary and is discarded when training ends; and the deployed policy is architecturally identical to the undistilled baseline, down to the number of flow steps. The grounding is inherited during training and carried for free thereafter. Sec. III gives the details.
blocks.zh: 以冷冻的世界模型提供目标。 两种设计选择使得客观价格低廉. 由于老师被冻结了,所以其目标只取决于训练框架,可以被一次,提前取出,并在训练期间读回,而不是重编;由于要求学生在方向上同意这些目标,而不是精确地复制,因此可以自由地保留其行动目标要求的任何附加结构,而两个骨干不需要共享特征空间或维度. 下面是两端都看不见的蒸馏程序。 培训从来不让教师留有记忆,因此一个蒸馏的运行成本与基线运行成本相同;校正头是辅助的,在培训结束后被丢弃;部署的政策在结构上与未固定的基线完全相同,下至流程步骤的数量. 在培训期间继承地基,此后免费使用。 三司详出.

Our 0.8 0.8 B student improves from 48.2 % 48.2\% to 50.5 % 50.5\% on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, within 4.3 4.3 points of the 4 4 B model of the same architecture, matches a 4 4 B π \pi -style policy at 28 / 30 28/30 on a real single-arm pick-and-place task while carrying a fifth of its parameters, and reaches 97.9 % 97.9\% on LIBERO, 2.6 2.6 points above the identical undistilled student. blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Vision-Language-Action Models
blocks.zh: A. 远景规划-语言-行动模式

blocks.en: VLA models are motivated by the observation that large vision-language models pretrained on internet-scale data already contain rich perceptual and semantic representations useful for robot manipulation. By adapting these models to predict control actions, recent work has shown that visuomotor policies can inherit broad semantic understanding and generalize across diverse tasks.
blocks.zh: VLA模型的动机是,人们观察到,在互联网规模数据上预先培训的大型视觉语言模型已经包含着丰富的感知和语义表现,可用于机器人操纵. 通过调整这些模型以预测控制行动,最近的工作表明,机动车政策可以继承广义的语义理解并概括各种任务。

blocks.en: OpenVLA [ 1 ] provides one of the earliest open-source works that validated this paradigm, using a 7B Llama-2 backbone. It discretizes continuous robot actions into bins, treats them as action tokens, and trains the model to autoregressively predict actions conditioned on visual observations and language instructions. More recent systems have extended this idea by adopting architectures designed specifically for efficient robot control. GR00T N1 [ 4 ] , for example, adopts a dual-system architecture in which a large vision-language backbone produces a latent action plan that conditions a lightweight diffusion action expert, enabling dexterous bimanual manipulation across multiple tasks. Similarly, π 0 \pi_{0} and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 2 , 3 ] build on PaliGemma [ 9 ] and adopt a comparable two-level design within a unified flow-matching framework: instead of separating the model into distinct modules, they integrate the action expert with the vision-language backbone by concatenating their query, key, and value representations and performing cross-attention at each layer. π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} further improves generalization through co-training objectives that extend supervision beyond action prediction.
blocks.zh: OpenVLA [1]提供了最早验证了这个范式的开源作品之一,使用7B Llama-2主干. 它将连续的机器人动作碟片化为bins,把它们当作动作符来对待,并训练模型自动地预测以视觉观察和语言指示为条件的行动. 更近期的系统通过采用专门为高效机器人控制而设计的架构来扩展了这一想法. 例如,GR00T N1[4]采用了一种双系统架构,其中大型的视觉语言主干线产生一种潜在的行动计划,以轻量级传播行动专家为条件,使双人操纵能够跨越多种任务。 同样地, ^ 0\pi_{0}和 ^ 0.5\_{0} [2, 3] 在PaliGemma [9] 的基础上, 在一个统一的流量匹配框架内采用可比的两级设计: 他们不把模型分为不同的模块,而是通过调和他们的查询,键和价值表达,并在每一层进行交叉关注,将行动专家与视觉语言主干结合. * 0.5\pi=0.5}通过共同培训目标,将监督范围扩大到行动预测之外,从而进一步改善一般化。

blocks.en: Our student comes from StarVLA [ 10 ] , a modular codebase that pairs a common vision-language backbone with interchangeable action heads, giving a family of policies (QwenGR00T, QwenPI, QwenOFT, QwenFAST) that differ only in how actions are produced.
blocks.zh: 我们的学生来自StarVLA [10],一个模块化的代码库,将一个共同的视觉语言骨干与可互换的动作头骨组合在一起,给一个只有行动产生方式的不同政策家族(QuenGR00T,QuenPI,QuenOFT,QuenFAST).

blocks.en: A parallel line of work pushes VLAs toward smaller budgets, which is the regime this paper targets. SmolVLA [ 11 ] trains a 2.2B policy that runs on consumer hardware, VLA-OS [ 12 ] dissects planning representations at 0.5B, and Seer [ 13 ] couples predictive inverse dynamics with visual forecasting at 0.57B. These models trade accuracy for deployability; our aim is to recover the accuracy without giving up the budget.
blocks.zh: 平行的一行工作将自愿援助推向较小的预算,这就是本文件的目标。 SmolVLA [11] 列车使用消费硬件运行的2.2B政策,VLA-OS [12]将规划表述解析为0.5B,而Seeer [13]夫妇预测反向动态,视觉预测为0.57B. 这些模型用精确度来交易可部署性;我们的目标是在不放弃预算的情况下恢复准确性。

blocks.en: II-B World Models
blocks.zh: II-B 世界模式

blocks.en: World models are trained to predict how a scene evolves, without necessarily emitting actions. Video generative models are the dominant instance: Wan [ 14 ] is a large-scale video diffusion transformer, and DreamDojo [ 15 ] learns a generalist robot world model from human video. Cosmos 3 [ 16 ] is an omnimodal mixture-of-transformers that combines an understanding tower, a generative tower, and action and audio towers in one checkpoint. A related family learns predictive representations without pixel reconstruction: V-JEPA 2 [ 17 ] pairs a self-supervised video encoder with an action-conditioned predictor trained in latent space, and serves as one of our ablation teachers.
blocks.zh: 对世界模型进行了培训,以预测一个场景是如何演变的,而不必采取排放行动。 视频基因模型是主要的例子: Wan [14]是一款大规模视频传播变相器,DreamDojo [15] 从人类视频中学习了通用机器人世界模型. Cosmos 3 [16]是一款将理解塔,基因塔,动作和音响塔结合在一个检查站的全相交织的变相器. 一个相关的家庭学会了没有像素重建的预测性表示:V-JEPA 2 [17] 配对自控的视频编码器,并配有在潜伏空间训练的动作条件预测器,并担任我们的发烧教师之一.

blocks.en: II-C World Action Models
blocks.zh: II-C 世界行动模式

blocks.en: World action models (WAMs) turn a world model into a policy, so that predicting the future and choosing an action are trained together. Cosmos-Policy [ 7 ] adapts a video-generation foundation model for control with minor architectural changes, folding robot state and value information into a shared latent that supports both action generation and future-state reasoning. WorldVLA [ 18 ] unifies action and image generation autoregressively in a single transformer. LingBot-VA [ 8 ] and DreamZero [ 6 ] instead decompose the problem into two stages, first predicting future frames and then using them as conditioning context for action prediction. Fast-WAM [ 19 ] , our second ablation teacher, builds a WAM on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 14 ] video diffusion transformer and is representative of the video-DiT branch of this family. More recent entries target the cost of the paradigm directly: OA-WAM [ 20 ] decomposes frames into object-addressable slots, and Light-WAM [ 21 ] performs future-video supervision in a downsampled latent space with a compact backbone.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式(WAMs)将世界模式转变为政策,从而共同培训预测未来和选择行动。 Cosmos-Policy [7] 将一个视频生成基础模型用于使用小的建筑变化来控制,将机器人状态和价值信息折叠成一个共享的潜伏,支持动作生成和未来状态推理. WorldVLA [18] 将单变压器中的动作和图像生成自动递减. LingBot-VA [8] 和 DreamZero [6] 转而将问题分解为两个阶段,首先预测未来帧,再用它们作为动作预测的调节上下文. Fast-WAM [19],我们的第二任通化老师,在Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [14]视频传播变压器上建造了WAM,并代表了这个家族的视频-DIT分支. 更近期的条目直接针对范式的成本: OA-WAM [20] 将帧分解为可处理对象的槽,而Light-WAM [21] 则在有紧凑主干线的被下取样后的潜在空间中进行未来-视频监督.

blocks.en: II-D Representation-Level Distillation
blocks.zh: II-D 代表级别扭曲

blocks.en: Classical knowledge distillation transfers a teacher’s output distribution [ 22 ] ; FitNets [ 23 ] showed that intermediate “hints” can transfer more than outputs alone. REPA [ 24 ] revived this idea in generative modeling, showing that aligning an intermediate diffusion-transformer feature to a frozen self-supervised encoder dramatically accelerates training, using a purely point-wise, projection-mediated cosine objective with no generative component. Our alignment term performs representation-level distillation with a world model. The difference that matters here is what the frozen encoder knows: because its training objective demanded predicting how scenes evolve, its features carry temporal and causal structure, and the student inherits that structure without ever predicting a future itself.
blocks.zh: 古典知识蒸馏可以转移教师的产出分布[22];FitNets[23]显示,中间 " 物品 " 的传输可能不止是产出。 REPA[24]在基因模型中重现了这一想法,表明将中间扩散-转化特性与被冷冻的自监督编码器相配合会大大地加速训练,使用纯点,投影-介导的余弦目标,没有基因成分. 我们的校正术语与世界模式进行代表级分解。 这里重要的区别在于被冻结的编码器所知道的:因为它的训练目标要求预测场景是如何演变的,它的特征带有时间和因果结构,学生继承了这个结构而从未预测过未来本身.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview of the method. Left: the frozen teacher world model feature extraction pipeline. Right: the training pipeline for the student VLA.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2:方法概述. 左:被冻结的教师世界模型特征取出管道. 右:学生VLA的训练管道.

blocks.en: Our method is one term added to ordinary VLA training: align the student’s pooled image-token features to those of a frozen world model (Fig. 2 ). Sec. III-A fixes the student and its usual action objective, Sec. III-B specifies the alignment term, and Sec. III-C the teacher, Cosmos3-Nano. The alternative teachers used in the ablations are described alongside their results in Sec. IV-E .
blocks.zh: 我们的方法是在普通的VLA训练中添加了一个术语:将学生的集合图像基特征与被冻结的世界模型(图2)的特征相配合. III-A Sec.确定学生及其通常的行动目标,III-B Sec.指定了校正术语,而III-C Sec. 教师Cosmos3-Nano. 在文稿中使用的替代教师在文稿中及其结果一并被描述。

blocks.en: III-A Student and Base Objective
blocks.zh: 学生和基地目标

blocks.en:
The student is a QwenGR00T policy: a Qwen3-VL-family vision-language backbone [ 25 ] followed by a GR00T-style flow-matching action expert [ 4 ] . Given observations 𝐨 t \mathbf{o}_{t} (one or multiple camera views, a language instruction, and proprioceptive state), the backbone produces final-layer hidden states h ⁡ ( 𝐨 t ) ∈ ℝ L × D s h(\mathbf{o}_{t})\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times D_{s}} , where L L is the number of prefix tokens (the image tokens of every view, the instruction tokens, and the state token) and D s D_{s} is the hidden dim; h i ​ ( 𝐨 t ) ∈ ℝ D s h_{i}(\mathbf{o}_{t})\in\mathbb{R}^{D_{s}} denotes the state at position i i . The action expert predicts a chunk of K K future actions 𝐚 t : t + K \mathbf{a}_{t:t+K} by velocity regression along a flow path. We deliberately exclude the action channel: teacher and student do not share an action parameterization, and a recipe that depends on teacher actions cannot be teacher-agnostic. blocks.en: Offline teacher cache. The teacher is run once, ahead of training; targets are written to a memory-mapped cache keyed ( trajectory id , base index ) (\text{trajectory id},\text{base index}) order. Hence, no teacher weights are loaded during training, teacher and student can live in incompatible environments, and one cache serves multiple students, since the projector auto-sizes to whatever ( D s , D t ) (D_{s},D_{t}) pair it is given. Each cached row is a single pooled vector per camera view, so the cache is cheap to store and cheap to produce: about an hour on four GPUs for LIBERO.
blocks.zh: 离线教师缓存. 老师在训练前运行一次;目标被写入一个被内存标记的缓存按键(轨迹 id, 基准索引) (\text{trajectory id},\text{base index}) 顺序 。 因此,在培训期间,没有教师的体重被装入,教师和学生可以生活在不相容的环境中,一个缓存为多个学生服务,因为投影仪自动大小为任意(Ds,Dt)(D_{s},D_{t})对它给出的一对. 每个缓存行是每个相机视图的单个集合向量,因此缓存价格便宜可以存储并便宜生产:大约一个小时为LIBERO的四个GPU.

blocks.en: III-C Teacher: Cosmos3-Nano
blocks.zh: 三-C 教师:宇宙3-纳诺

blocks.en: Our teacher throughout is the understanding tower of Cosmos 3 [ 16 ] , an omnimodal mixture-of-transformers world model. We extract its Qwen3-VL-8B reasoner from the unified checkpoint, dropping the other towers, and get the image-token hidden states at layer 24, mean-pooled per view, giving D t = 4096 D_{t}=4096 per view. The tower is deterministic: there is no diffusion timestep or sampling. We also ablate two alternative teachers in Sec. IV-E : Fast-WAM [ 19 ] , a world-action model built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video diffusion transformer [ 14 ] , and V-JEPA2-AC [ 17 ] , an action-conditioned predictive latent video model.
blocks.zh: 我们的老师是Cosmos 3 [16] 的理解塔, 一个全方位的转换器混合世界模型。 我们从统一的检查站取出它的Qune3-VL-8B 推理器,放下了其他的塔楼,并在第24层获得图像所隐藏的状态,每个视图平均集合,每个视图给予Dt=4096 D_{t}=-}=4096. 塔为定型:没有扩散时间步或取样. 我们还放弃了Sec. IV-E的两名替代教师:Fast-WAM [19],一个基于Wan2.2-TI2V-5B视频传播变压器的世界行动模型[14],以及V-JEPA2-AC [17],一个具有行动条件的预测潜伏视频模型.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: We evaluate on two simulation benchmarks and two real robots, one single-arm and one bimanual. The question in each case is the same: does aligning a compact student to a frozen world model’s representation buy accuracy that the same student cannot reach on its own, and how does the result compare to policies several times larger?
blocks.zh: 我们用两个模拟基准 和两个真正的机器人, 一个单臂和一个双人。 每一个案例都存在同样的问题:将一个紧凑的学生与一个被冻结的世界模式的代表关系联系起来,是否能够购买同一个学生自己无法接触到的准确性,结果如何与政策相比大了好几倍?

blocks.en: IV-A Setup
blocks.zh: 设置

blocks.en: LIBERO [ 26 ] : all four suites ( spatial , object , goal , libero-10 ), the training data consists of ∼ \sim 273k demonstration steps, two camera views. Checkpoints are evaluated on all four suites with 50 50 episodes per task, i.e. 500 500 trials per suite; we report the four-suite mean success rate SR avg \mathrm{SR}_{\mathrm{avg}} in percent.
blocks.zh: LIBERO [26]:所有四个套房(空间,对象,目标,libero-10),训练数据由\\sim 273k演示步骤,两个相机取景. 所有四个套房都评估了检查点,每个任务有50个50集,即每套500次试验;我们报告四个套房的平均成功率是 SR avg\ mathrm{SR}_{\ mathrm{avg}}%。

blocks.en: RoboCasa-GR1 [ 27 , 4 ] : 24 24 task environments of the GR1 Fourier humanoid (single ego camera, 29 29 -D bimanual action, 58 58 -D state), with 1,000 1{,}000 demonstrations per environment, 24 24 k episodes and 6.02 6.02 M steps in total. We train one policy on all 24 24 environments jointly and evaluate it on each of them, 20 20 episodes per environment, reporting the mean of the per-environment success rates.
blocks.zh: RoboCasa-GR1 [27,4]: GR1 Fourier人相机的24个任务环境(单自相机,29个29-D双人动作,58个58-D状态),每个环境有1000个1{,}000个演示,24个24千集,总共6.02个6.02分步. 我们对所有24个环境共同培训一项政策,对每个环境进行评估,每环境20集,报告每个环境成功率的平均值。

blocks.en: Real robots : an AgileX Nero run single-arm on two pick-and-place tasks, and TRIP-Bag [ 28 ] , a 7 7 -DoF bimanual platform, on a two-armed fruit handover (Sec. IV-D ).
blocks.zh: 真正的机器人: AgileX Nero在两个接地任务上运行单臂,而TRIP-Bag [28],一个7-DoF双人平台,在双臂水果交接上运行(Sec. IV-D.).

blocks.en: Training. All students are trained on 4 × 4{\times} A100-80GB with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 at effective batch 256 256 , under a cosine schedule with minimum LR decaying over the run’s full step budget.
blocks.zh: 培训。 A100-80GB与DeepSpeed ZeRO-2在256 256号有效批量下,

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol and its variance. Neither simulation benchmark is deterministic. The policies sample actions from a flow-matching head, so two rollouts from one checkpoint differ, and the simulator’s renderer is not bit-identical across GPU models, so the same checkpoint and the same seed can diverge on different hardware. Practitioners report both effects repeatedly [ 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] , but published tables are usually single numbers from a single machine. We therefore evaluate four times, crossing two evaluation seeds with two GPUs, an A100-80GB and an RTX 5090, and report the mean over those four runs with the standard deviation alongside. One interesting observation is that the two benchmarks are not equally stable. On LIBERO the spread is small, around a point to a point and a half, while on RoboCasa-GR1 the same checkpoint can move by several points when the GPU changes [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 评价协议及其差异。 模拟基准都不是决定性的。 政策样本从一个流相比头进行动作,因此从一个检查点推出两个不同,模拟器的渲染器在GPU模型上不是比特-等同的,因此同一个检查点和同一个种子可以在不同的硬件上相去甚远. 从业人员反复报告这两种影响[29.,30.,31.,32.,33.,34],但公布的表格通常是单机的单数. 因此,我们用两个GPU、一个A100-80GB和一个RTX 5090越过两个评价种子,并报告这四个种子的平均值与标准偏差并列。 一个有趣的观察是,这两个基准并不一致。 在LIBERO上,传播范围很小,大约为一分半,而在RoboCasa-GR1上,当GPU改变[34]时,同一检查站可以移动多分.

blocks.en: IV-B LIBERO
blocks.zh: 四-B 利贝罗

blocks.en: Table I places our distilled 0.8 0.8 B student against published VLA and world-model policies. It reaches 97.9 % 97.9\% average success, 2.6 2.6 points above the identical undistilled student. Our distilled model is still a touch behind the state-of-the-art VLA and World Model, however, the comparison at our own scale is the sharpest: every other policy below 4 4 B in this table sits between 78.7 % 78.7\% and 95.3 % 95.3\% .
blocks.zh: 表一列出我们毕业的0.8 B级学生与公布的VLA和世界模式政策。 平均成功率达到97.9%,比同一未毕业学生高2.6分。 我们的蒸馏模型仍然是最先进的VLA和World Model的后盾, 然而,我们自己的规模比较是最尖锐的:本表中4 B以下的所有其他政策在78.7%的78.7%到95.3%的95.3%之间。

blocks.zh: 机械卡萨-GR1

blocks.en: Table II isolates the contribution of the method: with the alignment term switched on, the same 0.8 0.8 B student improves from 48.2 % 48.2\% to 50.5 % 50.5\% success, a gain of 2.3 2.3 points, at zero inference cost. That is enough to move a 0.8 0.8 B policy past QwenFAST, QwenPI and QwenOFT and both Isaac-GR00T releases, and to within 4.3 4.3 points of the 4 4 B QwenGR00T ( 54.8 % 54.8\% ), of which our student is a five-fold reduction and which the same objective lifts again when applied to that backbone directly (Table IV ); the stronger published entries, all at 4 4 B or more, remain ahead.
blocks.zh: 表二隔离了该方法的贡献:随着对接术语的开通,同样的0.8 B类学生从48.2% 48.2\%提高到50.5% 50.5\%成功,增分2.3 2.3分,按零推论成本计算. 这足以使0.8 B政策超越QuenFAST、QuenPI和QuenOFT以及Isaac-GR00T的发行,并在4 B QuenGR00T(54.8%54.8%%)的4.3分之内移动,其中我们的学生是5倍的削减,当直接应用到这个主干时,同一目标再次升起(表四);更强的已公布条目,全部为4 4 B或更多,仍然在前面。

blocks.en: The stronger entries get there by building something: ACE-Ego-0 assembles roughly 600 600 M frames of robot and pseudo-action-labelled human video through a five-stage pipeline [ 45 ] , and PhysBrain a question-answer corpus, a retrained base VLM, and a dual-pathway adaptation architecture [ 44 ] . We rely on large-scale pretraining too, but only through a world model that already exists and that we neither train nor deploy: the recipe adds one additional simple loss, needs no data beyond the original training data, and leaves the deployed policy unchanged.
blocks.zh: ACE-Ego-0 组装大约600 600 M帧的机器人和被伪动作标记的人类视频通过五相管 [45],而PhysBrain则通过问答,再训练基础VLM,以及双向适应架构 [44]. 我们也依靠大规模的预训,但只能通过一个已经存在并且我们既不训练也不部署的世界模式:配方又增加了一个简单的损失,除了最初的训练数据之外不需要任何数据,而部署的政策不变.

blocks.en: IV-D Real-Robot Manipulation
blocks.zh: IV-D 实际机器人操纵

blocks.en: Simulation results are only as good as their transfer, so we validate on hardware. The evaluation is built to vary one thing at a time. We begin on an AgileX Nero, a 7 7 -DoF arm operated single-arm, with two separate pick-and-place tasks, one on fruit and one on eggs; we then carry the fruit task over to TRIP-Bag [ 28 ] , a 7 7 -DoF bimanual platform, and rebuild it as a two-armed handover. The second step changes the embodiment, the number of arms, the cameras, and the controller latencies at once, so it asks whether the gain is a property of the method or of one particular setup.
blocks.zh: 模拟结果只能和它们的传输一样好,所以我们在硬件上验证. 评估的建立 一次改变一件事。 我们从AgileX Nero开始,一个7-DoF的手臂操作了单臂,有两个独立的取出和放置任务,一个在水果上,一个在鸡蛋上;然后我们把水果任务带到TRIP-Bag[28],一个7-DoF双臂平台,并重建为双臂移交. 第二步会同时改变浮雕,手臂数量,相机,以及控制器的后缀,因此它会问增益是方法的财产,还是某个特定的设置的财产.

blocks.en: Task 1: fruit pick-and-place (single-arm). Fruits lie on the table in front of the robot and a basket sits at the edge of the workspace. The arm must locate each fruit in turn, grasp it, lift it clear of the table, and release it into the basket.
blocks.zh: 任务1:取果接地(单臂). 水果放在机器人前面的桌子上,一个篮子坐在工作空间的边缘. 手臂必须依次定位出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出入出出出出出出出入入入出入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入

blocks.en: Task 2: egg pick-and-place (single-arm). The two eggs sit in a crate and must be moved one at a time into a basket. An egg is smooth, close to spherical, and slippery, so a grasp that would hold a fruit slides off it, and the shell tolerates only a narrow band of closing force. The difficulty is in how the object responds to contact rather than in finding it.
blocks.zh: 任务2:取蛋接地(单臂). 两只鸡蛋坐入一箱,必须一次搬入一篮. 蛋是光滑的,接近球形的,又滑,所以一个能把水果滑走的接住,而外壳只能容忍一束狭窄的收缩力. 困难在于对象如何应对接触,而不是找到.

blocks.en: Task 3: bimanual fruit handover (TRIP-Bag). Three fruits lie on the table and an open bag sits at the left edge of the workspace. For each fruit, the right arm must locate and grasp it, lift it clear of the table, hand it over to the left gripper in mid-air, and the left arm must then release it into the bag. The policy repeats this for all three fruits. Making the handover explicit forces the two arms into a timed dependency, and the bag is deformable, so its opening geometry changes as it fills.
blocks.zh: 任务3:双人水果交接(TRIP-Bag). 3个水果放在桌子上,一个开口的袋子坐在工作空间的左边缘. 对每种水果,右臂必须定位并抓住它,从桌子上抬出,在中空交给左握手,左臂再放入袋子. 该政策对所有三种水果都重复了这一点。 使交接明确使两臂形成定时的依附关系,包被变形,于是其开口几何变化随所填充.

blocks.en: In all three tasks the objects are cleared one at a time and a trial counts as a success only if every one of them ends up inside the target receptacle, so an object dropped on the way or left resting on the rim fails the trial outright. We fine-tune each policy per platform on roughly 30 30 min of teleoperated demonstration for the single-arm tasks and 1 1 h for the bimanual one, and score 30 30 trials per policy, task, and platform.
blocks.zh: 在所有三项任务中,物体一次被清除一次,试验只有在每个物体最后都进入目标贮器时才算成功,因此,一个物体在途中被扔出或留在圆柱上完全没有完成试验。 我们在每个平台对每个政策进行微调,大约30分钟为单臂任务进行远程操作演示,1小时为双臂任务,每个政策、任务和平台进行30个试验。

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Successful rollouts of the distilled 0.8 0.8 B student on the three real-robot tasks, recorded from a third-person camera. Each dashed box is one episode: (a) fruit and (b) egg pick-and-place on the AgileX Nero, and (c) the fruit task on TRIP-Bag.
blocks.zh: 图3:从第三人称相机录制的被分馏出0.8 0.8 B级学生成功出道,完成三项真机器人任务. 每个破碎的盒子是一集:(a) 水果和(b) AgileX Nero上摘取和放置鸡蛋, (c) TRIP-Bag上的水果任务.

blocks.en: TABLE III: Real-robot evaluation, success rate (%) over 30 30 trials per cell.
blocks.zh: 表三:实际机器人评价,成功率(%),每间试验30次以上。

blocks.en: Fig. 3 shows a successful rollout, and Table III the scores. The same pattern as GR1 holds, and the three columns order themselves by difficulty. On the single-arm fruit task the distilled 0.8 0.8 B policy reaches 93.3 % 93.3\% ( 28 / 30 28/30 ), matching the 4 4 B π \pi -style policy and 3 3 trials above the undistilled control. On the egg task every policy drops, mostly due to slippage during grasping the eggs. The gap that opens is the informative part: the control falls to 46.7 % 46.7\% ( 14 / 30 14/30 ) while distillation recovers 4 4 of the 7 7 trials separating it from the 4 4 B policy, reaching 60.0 % 60.0\% ( 18 / 30 18/30 ) against 70.0 % 70.0\% ( 21 / 30 21/30 ). Moving to two arms costs every policy again, and the same relation holds, 40.0 % 40.0\% for the control, 46.7 % 46.7\% for ours, 53.3 % 53.3\% for the 4 4 B policy.

Fig. 4: Failure modes, fruit (top) and egg (bottom); the ring marks the failure. (a) Dropped before the receptacle. (b) Closed on the rim, not the fruit. (c) Egg slips from the grasp. (d) Egg slips mid-carry.
blocks.zh: 发相. 4:失败模式,果(上)和卵(下);环会标志着失败. (a) 在贮器前投掷。 (b) 关闭在环上,而不是水果上。 (c) 鸡蛋滑出。 (d) 鸡蛋中途滑行。

blocks.en: Failure modes. The failures are not uniform, and the modes that dominate are shown in Fig. 4 . All are errors of placement rather than of recognition: the policy consistently finds the target and reaches for the right one, and what it misses is the last few centimetres, either letting go early on the way to the receptacle or closing on the receptacle’s own geometry when the two are close enough to overlap in the image. The egg task adds a grasp variant of the same error: the fingers close on the egg and lift, but the shell slips sideways (Fig. 4 c). When an egg slips out mid-carry (Fig. 4 d), the policy still tracks it and reaches for it again, so it is the contact that fails, not the scene understanding. This is what we would expect a representational prior to help with least, since none of these modes is a failure to understand the scene.
blocks.zh: 失败模式 。 失败并不统一,支配模式用"Fig"来显示. 4 (韩语). 所有这些都是放置错误,而不是识别错误:保险单总是找到目标,并达到正确的目标,它错过的只是最后几厘米,要么在前往贮器的路上提早放行,要么在两者相近足以使图像重叠时关闭贮器自己的几何图案。 卵子任务增加了同一种误差的抓取变体:手指会紧紧地靠近卵子和抬起,但外壳会滑出侧道(图4 c). 当一个蛋从中产地滑出(图4d)时,保单仍然跟踪它并再次到达它,所以接触失败,而不是场景理解. 这是我们在帮助最少之前所期望的代表性,因为这些模式都不是不了解现场。

blocks.en: IV-E Ablations
blocks.zh: 四-E 结 论

blocks.en: The ablations ask which parts of the recipe matter. The student and alignment-layer ablations are run on RoboCasa-GR1, which has the headroom to separate the variants; the teacher ablation is run on LIBERO to utilize existing pretrained teacher models. The RoboCasa-GR1 ablations are scored only once on A100 due to limited computational resources.
blocks.zh: 药方的哪部分很重要 在RoboCasa-GR1上进行学生和校正级活动,该校设有将变体分离的教学室;在LIBERO上进行教师校正级活动,利用现有的经过预先培训的教师模式。 RoboCasa-GR1分数由于计算资源有限,在A100上只得一分.

blocks.en: Student scale and backbone (Table IV ). The recipe is defined on the student’s pooled image-token hidden states and nothing else, so it carries across student sizes and backbone families without modification: the projector auto-sizes to whatever student width it is given. We therefore repeat it at 4 4 B within the same backbone family and at 1 1 B on a different one.
blocks.zh: 学生规模和骨干(表四)。 食谱被定义在学生集合的图像卡通隐藏状态上,而不是其他的状态上,因此它可以不作修改地跨过学生大小和骨干家庭:投影机自动大小到任何学生宽度。 因此,我们在同一骨干家庭的4个4个B和一个不同的1个B重复。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Student scale and backbone family ablation on RoboCasa-GR1. w/o is the same student trained without the alignment term. Single A100 run, so these differ from the four-run means of Table II .
blocks.zh: 表格 四:RoboCasa-GR1上的学生规模和骨干家庭。 w/o是同一个没有校正术语训练的学生. 单A100运行,所以这些与表二的四跑方式不同.

blocks.en: Which student layer to align (Table V ). The alignment term needs one hidden state from the student, and nothing in the derivation says which. We sweep the alignment point across the depth of the 0.8 0.8 B student, at a third, a half, two thirds, and the final layer. To keep the sweep affordable we run each variant on RoboCasa-GR1 for a quarter of the full schedule, so the absolute numbers sit below Table II and only the ordering is meaningful. Every choice trains stably and lands within four points of the best, but the ordering is not monotonic in depth: the final layer is best at 49.8 % 49.8\% , the half-depth layer is within half a point of it at 49.4 % 49.4\% , and the two-thirds layer is the weakest at 45.9 % 45.9\% . We read this as the objective being tolerant of where it is attached rather than as evidence for a particular depth, since the spread between the best and second-best layers is smaller than what a quarter-length schedule can resolve. We keep the final layer, which is also the cheapest to implement: it is the representation the action head already consumes, so no intermediate layer’s activation has to be retained for loss computation.
blocks.zh: 哪个学生层对齐(表五). 校对词需要学生隐藏的状态,而衍生词中没有任何内容说出哪个. 我们把校对点扫到 0.8 B学生的深度, 三分之一,一半,三分之二,最后一层。 为了保持扫地价格,我们在RoboCasa-GR1上运行了每个变体的四分之一的完整时间表,所以绝对数字位于表二下方,只有订购才有意义. 每个选择都以"最优"的四分内出动并着陆,但订单不是一分一分的深度:最后一层最好为49.8% 49.8\%;半深层在它的半分内为49.4% 49.4\%;而三分之二层最弱为45.9% 45.9\%. 我们认为,这一目标是容忍附着在什么地方,而不是作为具体深度的证据,因为最佳和第二最佳两层之间的分布比四分之一长的时间表所能解决的要小。 我们保留最后一层,这也是最便宜的一层:这是动作头已经消耗的表示,所以不能保留中间层的活性来计算损失。

blocks.en: TABLE V: Student layer ablation on RoboCasa-GR1. Trained for a quarter of the full schedule and evaluated once on an A100, so the rates sit below Table II .
blocks.zh: 表五:RoboCasa-GR1上的学生层。 培训时间为全部时间表的四分之一,每100澳元评估一次,因此费率低于表二。

blocks.en: Teacher (Table VI ). The claim we want to test is that a world model helps, not that this world model helps, so we repeat the recipe with two teachers chosen to differ from Cosmos3-Nano, and from each other, on every axis available: training objective, architecture, and feature width. Fast-WAM [ 19 ] is a world-action model built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video diffusion transformer [ 14 ] ; we read the frame-0 hidden state of its video expert at layer 15 of 30. V-JEPA2-AC [ 17 ] pairs a self-supervised ViT-g/16 video encoder with an action-conditioned predictor; we post-train it on the target dataset and read the predictor’s pre-projection hidden state.
blocks.zh: 教师(表六)。 我们想要测试的主张是,一个世界模式有帮助,而不是这个世界模式有帮助,所以我们用选择与宇宙3-纳诺不同的两位老师重复这个食谱,并且相互重复,在每个可用的轴线上:培训目标,建筑,和地物宽度。 Fast-WAM [19]是一款以Wan2.2-TI2V-5B相机传播变压器为基础的世界动作模型 [14];我们在30层第15层读取了它的相机专家的帧-0隐藏状态. V-JEPA2-AC [17] 配对自导自导自导的VIT-g/16视频编码器,并配有动作条件的预测器;我们在目标数据集上对它进行后训练,并读取预测器的预预测隐藏状态.

blocks.en: Every teacher improves on the undistilled control of Table I ( 95.3 95.3 ): V-JEPA2-AC by 1.2 1.2 points, Fast-WAM by 1.6 1.6 , and Cosmos3-Nano by 2.6 2.6 . What matters most is the consistency across teachers: since all three lift the same student, the transferred signal is best attributed to world-model representations in general rather than to Cosmos3-Nano specifically. The benefit is thus a property of the recipe rather than of a particular teacher.
blocks.zh: 每个教师都改进了表一(95.3 95.3):V-JEPA2-AC 1.2分,快WAM 1.6 1.6分,Cosmos3-Nano 2.6 2.6分。 最重要的是教师之间的一致性:由于所有三个学生都举起同一个学生,转接的信号最好归结为一般的世界模式代表,而不是Cosmos3-Nano。 因此,津贴是食谱的财产,而不是特定教师的财产。

blocks.zh: 表六:教师对利伯罗的不满。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: World models earn their grounding by predicting the future, and that same prediction is what keeps them out of a control loop. We showed the two can be pulled apart. A compact policy aligned once, offline, to a frozen world model’s visual features keeps some of what that grounding is worth while deploying exactly the network it would have deployed anyway, at no cost in latency or memory. The gains are modest but consistent, in both simulation environments (LIBERO, RoboCasa-GR1) and real-robot experiments, and they hold across student scales, backbones, alignment layers, and teachers, which is the pattern one would expect from a representational prior rather than from a coincidence between two networks.
blocks.zh: 世界模型通过预测未来来获得基础,同样的预测使得它们无法进入控制循环. 我们证明两者可以分开 紧凑的政策一度离线,与被冻结的世界模型的视觉特征一致,但保留了这种定位的一些价值,同时精确地部署它无论如何会部署的网络,而无需花费时间或记忆。 在模拟环境(LIBERO、RoboCasa-GR1)和真机器人实验中,这些成果是有限的,但是一致的。 它们跨越学生规模、骨干、校正层和教师,这是人们期望从前一种代表性而不是从两个网络之间的巧合中得到的模式。
